notes: s020 and s022 are joined under rule 59's plain-indefinite arm; reading 'nothing' as the negator's alone and leaving ti unrepresented is the competing analysis, but ti carries no negation of its own.
Σπλαγχνίζομαι is denominal, so 'have compassion' heads on 'compassion' under rules 66 and 91.
θέλω heads on 'would', which is the lexical rendering of the verb and not an auxiliary; 'lest haply' heads on the conjunction word with 'haply' as a rule 7 helper.
